args.title: Fix token lifetime parsing for TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The token lifetime is calculated using `int("TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES", file.auth?.tokenTtlMinutes ?? 60)`, and setting `TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES` to '12h' causes it to be parsed incorrectly, thus leading to a token lifetime of just 12 minutes.
